title: GTA VI: RDR2 Realism Wishlist
label: WISHLIST — NOT CONFIRMED
script: Could GTA Six borrow realism from Red Dead Redemption Two? Fans would love smarter wildlife, dynamic characters, and richer environmental details. Rockstar has shown the world of Leonida, but these specific Red Dead features are not all confirmed. What would you want most?
